title: Options for the supporters and traffic tips 2026 — Zegama-Aizkorri
claims: The organiser's spectator guide calls Sancti Spiritu 'the mythical point of the race' and says the Supporter Point is located there.

The same guide gives three ways to reach Sancti Spiritu: a bus from Zegama plus a 6.3 km walk with 450 m of ascent; a 6.9 km walk from the Zegama square with 661 m of ascent; and a shuttle from the Suazarreta car park to the Otzaurte pass followed by a 5 km climb with 460 m of ascent.
The same guide says the bus to the train station runs from 06:30 to 08:00 and needs no reservation, and that the shuttle from Suazarreta starts at 06:00.
